query:
SELECT 
  'receivablePayments' as tabela,
  COUNT(*) as total_registros,
  COUNT(paidDate) as registros_com_data,
  MIN(paidDate) as data_mais_antiga,
  MAX(paidDate) as data_mais_recente
FROM receivablePayments
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'receivableInstallments',
  COUNT(*),
  COUNT(paidDate),
  MIN(paidDate),
  MAX(paidDate)
FROM receivableInstallments
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'purchaseInstallments',
  COUNT(*),
  COUNT(paidDate),
  MIN(paidDate),
  MAX(paidDate)
FROM purchaseInstallments
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'expenseInstallments',
  COUNT(*),
  COUNT(paidDate),
  MIN(paidDate),
  MAX(paidDate)
FROM expenseInstallments
